account.company_edit_hint: Company details are maintained by the shop. Contact us to change them.

checkout.note_placeholder: Any special instructions for this order

admin.title: Admin
admin.refund_prompt: {amount} has been paid. Choose where the refund goes.
admin.return_withdrawn_notice: The customer withdrew this request before it was inspected. Nothing was received and no refund is due.
admin.quick_search_purpose: One box for the whole panel. An order number, barcode or SKU that matches exactly opens that record straight away.
admin.quick_search_idle_hint: Orders, products, stock items and customers — all at once.
admin.dashboard_purpose: What is waiting on you right now. Every tile opens the screen that clears it.
admin.tile_unpaid_hint: Not paid, or paid in part
admin.tile_awaiting_quote_hint: Shipping is on contact — nobody has quoted yet
admin.tile_low_stock_hint: At or below the minimum level
admin.no_orders_yet_hint: Orders placed on the storefront appear here.
admin.orders_purpose: Prepare, hand over, take payment and invoice. Cancelling asks where the money goes back to.
admin.order_detail_purpose: One order end to end: items, payments, invoice and internal notes.
admin.confirm_deliver: Mark this order as handed over? This releases the reserved stock and completes the order.
admin.confirm_cancel_order: Cancel order {number}? Stock goes back and any payment is returned as chosen above. This cannot be undone.

catalog.add_variant_hint: A name is enough — every other field is optional.
catalog.custom_details_purpose: Reusable product details such as dimensions, materials and staff-only shelf notes.
catalog.details_note: Images and variants save separately, in their own panels below.
catalog.image_upload_hint: The image uploads as soon as you pick it — no need to save the product.
catalog.new_custom_detail_hint: Create it here, then save its value above.
catalog.no_custom_details_hint: Create a detail such as Dimensions, then apply it on a product.
catalog.no_variants: This product has no variants yet
catalog.no_variants_hint: The product sells as a single item. Add variants only if it comes in more than one specification.
catalog.products_purpose: Everything the shop sells. Visibility decides whether shoppers see a product; price changes may need a second approval.
catalog.no_products_hint: Add the first product, or bring stock in through a shipment.
catalog.tags_purpose: Keywords that group products across categories. Each tag gets its own page, and its words are folded into search.
catalog.confirm_retire_attribute: Retire {name}? {count} active value(s) will be closed.
catalog.no_tags_hint: Create a tag, then apply it to products from the product screen.
catalog.tag_unused_hint: No product carries this tag, so its page is empty.
catalog.confirm_retire_tag: Retire the tag “{name}”? It will be removed from {count} product(s) and its page will stop working.
catalog.slug_hint: Used in the public URL. Leave blank to generate one.
catalog.product_tags_hint: Tags make this product findable outside its category, and their words are searchable.
catalog.confirm_close_category: Close this category? Only an empty category with no sub-categories can be closed.
catalog.confirm_close_variant: Retire this variant? It stops being sellable. Past orders keep it.
catalog.confirm_remove_image: Remove this image? It disappears from the product page.
catalog.confirm_close_discount: End this discount now? Prices go back to normal immediately.
catalog.categories_purpose: The shop's structure. A category can only be closed once it is empty and has no sub-categories.
catalog.product_purpose: Everything about one product: its text, images, variants, price and discounts.
catalog.new_product_purpose: The minimum to create the product. Images, variants and discounts come next, on its own screen.
catalog.reviews_purpose: Every review waits here until someone publishes it — nothing reaches a product page unmoderated.
catalog.moderation_note_hint: Internal — the customer never sees this.
catalog.no_reviews_hint: Reviews customers write appear here for approval.
catalog.confirm_reject_review: Reject this review? It stays on record but never appears on the product page.

promocodes.confirm_retire: Retire this promocode? Shoppers can no longer apply it. Redemptions already made are kept.
promocodes.name: Name
promocodes.purpose: Discount codes, their limits and what they have been used on. Retiring a code stops new uses without touching past ones.
promocodes.detail_purpose: This code's limits, the products and categories it applies to, and how often it has been used.

approvals.none_pending: Nothing is waiting for your approval
approvals.none_submitted: You have not submitted any requests
approvals.cannot_approve_own: You cannot approve a request you submitted yourself.
approvals.not_a_checker: You are not an eligible checker for this request.
approvals.confirm_reject: Reject this request? The action is discarded and the maker will have to submit it again.
approvals.confirm_withdraw: Withdraw your request? It will not be carried out.
approvals.purpose: Actions parked for a second pair of eyes. You can never approve your own.
approvals.detail_purpose: Exactly what will happen if you approve this, and the note the maker left.

access.confirm_revoke: Revoke this permission? The person loses the screen it opens on their next page load.
access.purpose: Who may do what, per module and per action — and which of those actions need a second person's approval.

users.confirm_deactivate: Deactivate this account? They can no longer sign in. The account is kept, not deleted.
users.purpose: Staff accounts and their roles. Deactivating keeps the account and its history; nothing is deleted.

sessions.confirm_terminate: Sign this session out? The person is signed out on that device straight away.
sessions.purpose: Who is signed in right now, and recent sign-in attempts. Ending a session signs that device out at once.

audit.purpose: Every change, who made it and what it was before. Entries are permanent and cannot be edited.
audit.no_entries_hint: Changes staff make are recorded here as they happen.

returns.restock_per_line: What goes back on the shelf?
returns.restock_hint: Unchecked items are written off as damaged.
returns.nothing_returnable_hint: Every item on this order has been returned or not yet delivered.
returns.inspection_notice: We inspect every returned item before issuing a refund. We will email you once the inspection is done.
returns.submitted_notice: Your return request has been received. We will email you once the item has been inspected.
returns.withdrawn_notice: Your return request has been withdrawn.
returns.none_yet_hint: Requests you raise against a delivered order appear here.
returns.refunded_to_cash: refunded to your original payment method
returns.error_no_items: Choose at least one item to return.
returns.error_no_reason: Choose a reason for the return.
returns.error_too_many: Some of those quantities are no longer available to return. Please check and try again.
returns.new_purpose: Record what is coming back and why. Nothing is refunded until the return is inspected.
returns.pick_order_hint: Start by finding the order the goods came from.
returns.pick_order_none: No order matches. Check the number on the invoice.
returns.confirm_create: Create this return? Staff must still inspect it before any refund is issued.
returns.purpose: Goods coming back. Nothing is refunded until the item has been inspected.
returns.detail_purpose: Inspect the goods, then decide the refund and where it goes.
returns.admin_none_yet_hint: Customers raise their own from their account; staff raise one here against an order.

inventory.close_hint: Adjustments are only written when the count is closed.
inventory.freeze_hint: System quantities are frozen when the count opens.
inventory.pool_hint: A line may override the invoice location.
inventory.confirm_write_off: Write this stock off? The quantity leaves the ledger and its cost is charged to the shop.
inventory.confirm_close_stock_take: Close this stock take? The counted variances are posted to the ledger and cannot be recounted.
inventory.purpose: What is on hand, what is reserved and what is sellable, with the weighted-average cost behind it.
inventory.item_purpose: One item's stock across branches, its movement history and its current average cost.
inventory.shipments_purpose: Goods coming in. Landed costs are spread over the lines, which is what re-averages the cost of each item.
inventory.shipment_purpose: One shipment, its lines and the cost each unit landed at.
inventory.new_shipment_purpose: Record goods arriving. Costs in USD are converted at the rate you enter.
inventory.transfers_purpose: Move stock between branches. It sits in transit until the receiving branch confirms it.
inventory.stock_takes_purpose: Count what is really on the shelf. The system quantity is frozen when the count opens.
inventory.stock_take_purpose: Enter the counted quantities. Closing the count posts every variance to the ledger.
inventory.labels_purpose: Printable barcode labels for the items you selected.
inventory.no_positions_hint: Stock appears once a shipment has been received.

money.confirm_close_box: Close this money box? No further transactions can be recorded against it.
money.purpose: Every till and account. Balances are computed from their transactions, never stored.
money.box_purpose: This box's ledger, its computed balance and its reconciliations.
money.new_box_purpose: A till, a bank account or a safe. Its opening balance is the only figure entered by hand.

reports.no_movements: No money movements in this period
reports.no_costs: No operating costs in this period
reports.directory_purpose: Every report, in CSV, Excel, PDF or a print view. Date-ranged reports use the period chosen above.
reports.purpose: The money picture for a period, and the reports behind it.
reports.recurring_hint: Recorded for reference — recurring costs are not posted automatically.
reports.about_financial_statement: Sales, cost of goods, operating costs and net profit.
reports.about_sales: Every order in the period, with its totals.
reports.about_operating_costs: Costs recorded in the period, by category.
reports.about_inventory: On-hand, reserved and sellable stock, with average cost.
reports.about_low_stock: Only the items at or below their minimum level.
reports.about_consignment: Who holds what on behalf of whom, and what is owed.
reports.about_money_boxes: Every box and its computed balance.
reports.about_promocodes: Each code, how often it was used and what it cost.
reports.about_returns: Returns raised in the period, with reason and refund.
reports.about_staff_activity: What each staff member changed, from the audit log.

consignment.split_basis_hint: Choose whether the consignor split uses the discounted selling price or the original list price.
consignment.confirm_loss: Record this as damaged or lost? The cost is written off and the consignor's split is adjusted.
consignment.confirm_close: Close this arrangement? No further items can be placed or settled against it.
consignment.purpose: Goods sold on behalf of others, and ours held by others. Each sale splits by the agreed share.
consignment.detail_purpose: What is held, what has sold, and what is owed either way.
consignment.new_purpose: Set up an arrangement with a consignor and agree the split before any item is placed.

content.reorder_fallback: Save the current order without dragging.
content.no_sections_hint: Add a section to build the homepage.
content.priority_hint: Higher shows first when several are live.
content.confirm_close_branch: Close this branch? It disappears from the storefront. A branch still holding stock cannot be closed.
content.confirm_remove_announcement: Remove this announcement bar? It stops showing on the storefront.
content.confirm_remove_section: Remove this homepage section? The homepage stops showing it.
content.confirm_remove_rule: Remove this shipping rule? Orders to that area fall back to the remaining rules.
content.homepage_purpose: The blocks the homepage is built from, in the order shoppers see them.
content.announcements_purpose: The strip above the header. Bars can be scheduled, and the highest priority one shows.
content.settings_purpose: Footer text, contact details and social links, in both languages.
content.emails_purpose: The wording of every automatic email. Placeholders in braces are filled in when it is sent.
content.shipping_purpose: What shipping costs, by governorate — including free above a threshold, and “we will contact you”.

exports.pdf_unavailable: PDF export unavailable — use the print view and save as PDF.

invoice.currency_note: All amounts are in Jordanian dinars ({currency}).
invoice.thanks: Thank you for shopping with JEC Store.
